title: 第8章 破境筑基
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

深邃的矿洞内，死一般的寂静。

林渊站在那黑漆漆的洞口前，按在储物袋上的手掌微微渗出冷汗。

多年的谨慎，他清楚任何一处反常的寒意，都可能意味着隐匿的妖兽，亦或是某种未知的天然禁制。

他没有贸然深入，而是敛声屏气，将身形缩在岩壁的阴影中，右手悄然扣住了一枚金针。

足足等了半柱香的工夫，直到确认那股寒意并无后续的灵力波动，只是地下深处阴气汇聚的自然侵蚀后，他才暗自松了一口气。

“既然打定主意要安稳度过这七日大限，便容不得半点赌的成分。”

林渊眼神微凝，侧身潜入矿洞。

他足足往下深入了百余丈，沿途凭着老祖记忆中的隐秘路线，绕开了几处早已坍塌的废弃矿道。

最终，在一条近乎垂直向下的隐蔽裂缝尽头，他寻到了当年老祖闭关的密道。

这里宽不过数丈，头顶是厚重的玄铁矿脉残渣，天然隔绝神识。

而在地面裂隙间，隐隐有丝缕精纯的灵气溢出——此处正是那条一阶灵脉分支的源头。

林渊不敢耽搁，当即一拍储物袋，取出那套被他强行修改过的幻阵阵盘。

他将四面阵旗依照玄金锁灵的方位，严丝合缝地打入四周岩壁的缝隙中。

随着他往阵盘中心嵌入一块下品灵石，嗡的一声低鸣，一层淡淡的微光荡漾开来，随之化为与周围毫无二致的灰黑岩壁。

四周泛起的灵气波动，被这层伪装死死锁在方圆三丈之内，没有泄露半点出去。

做完这一切，林渊这才盘膝坐下。

他先是取出一粒回气丹吞服，闭目调息。

突破筑基是生命层次的跃迁，经脉、丹田皆要承受灵力液化的狂暴冲击，必须将状态调整至凡躯的巅峰。

《玄金诀》在体内缓缓运转，九个周天过去，他原本因法器反噬而隐隐作痛的经脉终于彻底平复，体内的气态灵力饱满得犹如一汪沸腾的池水。

“成败在此一举。”

林渊睁开眼，眸中闪过一丝决然，一翻手，一个贴着青色符箓的精致玉瓶落在掌心。

揭开符箓，刹那间，一股浓郁到近乎化不开的药香扑鼻而来。

只见玉瓶内，一粒龙眼大小、通体浑圆的丹药正静静躺着，丹药表面有三道清晰的淡金色纹路交织，显得神秘莫测。

中品筑基丹。

放眼整个青阳郡，普通散修这辈子打破头也只能争抢寻常的下品筑基丹，而这粒品质上乘的中品灵丹，药力非凡。

林渊没有丝毫犹豫，张口便将丹药吞入腹中。

“轰！”

筑基丹一入腹，便化作一股极其恐怖的热流，犹如火山爆发般，顺着他的经脉疯狂冲入四肢百骸。

若是寻常的杂灵根修士，面对如此狂暴的药力，单是引导其拓宽经脉，便要承受剥皮抽筋般的痛苦。

然而，林渊身为万里挑一的金灵根，在这一刻展现出了近乎恐怖的优势。

金主肃杀，其质最坚。

Page (1/3)

Inside the deep mine, there was deathly silence.

Lin Yuan stood in front of the dark hole, sweating slightly from the palm of his hand that was pressed on the storage bag.

After many years of caution, he knew that any abnormal chill might mean a hidden monster or some unknown natural restriction.

He did not rush deeper, but held his breath, huddled in the shadow of the rock wall, and quietly held a golden needle in his right hand.

After waiting for half a stick of incense, he secretly breathed a sigh of relief after confirming that the chill had no subsequent spiritual fluctuations and was just the natural erosion caused by the gathering of Yin Qi deep underground.

"Since I have made up my mind to survive these seven days safely, there is no room for any gambling."

Lin Yuan's eyes narrowed slightly and he sneaked into the mine sideways.

He went down more than a hundred feet, and along the way, he used the secret route in his ancestor's memory to avoid several abandoned mine tunnels that had long since collapsed.

Finally, at the end of a hidden crack that went almost vertically downward, he found the secret passage where his ancestor had retreated.

This place is only a few feet wide, and the top of the head is covered with the remains of thick black iron veins, which naturally blocks out spiritual consciousness.

And in the cracks on the ground, there are faint traces of pure spiritual energy overflowing - this is the source of the first-order spiritual vein branch.

Lin Yuan did not dare to delay, and immediately patted the storage bag and took out the set of phantom array disks that he had forcibly modified.

He drove the four formation flags into the gaps in the surrounding rock walls according to the direction of the black gold lock spirit.

As he embedded a low-grade spiritual stone into the center of the array, there was a low buzz, and a layer of faint light rippled, then turned into a gray-black rock wall that was no different from the surrounding one.

The spiritual energy fluctuations that appeared all around were tightly locked within a three-foot radius by this layer of disguise, and no trace of them leaked out.

After doing all this, Lin Yuan sat down cross-legged.

He first took out a Qi Restoration Pill and swallowed it, closing his eyes and adjusting his breath.

Breaking through the foundation building is a leap in the level of life. The meridians and Dantian must withstand the violent impact of liquefied spiritual power, and the state must be adjusted to the peak of the mortal body.

"Xuanjin Jue" slowly circulated in his body. After nine weeks, his meridians, which had been aching due to the backlash of the magical weapon, finally completely calmed down. The gaseous spiritual power in his body was as full as a boiling pool of water.

"Success or failure lies in one move."

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a trace of determination flashed in his eyes. He turned his hand, and an exquisite jade bottle with a cyan talisman fell into his palm.

When he opened the talisman, a medicinal fragrance so strong that it was almost indissoluble hit his nostrils.

Inside the jade bottle, a round elixir the size of a dragon's eye was lying quietly. There were three clear light golden lines intertwined on the surface of the elixir, making it appear mysterious and unpredictable.

A middle-grade foundation-building pill.

Looking at the entire Qingyang County, ordinary casual cultivators can only fight for ordinary low-grade foundation-building pills in their lifetime, but this high-quality mid-grade elixir has extraordinary medicinal power.

Lin Yuan didn't hesitate at all, opened his mouth and swallowed the pill.

"Boom!"

As soon as the Foundation Establishment Pill entered his abdomen, it turned into an extremely terrifying stream of heat, like a volcano erupting, rushing crazily along his meridians and into his limbs and bones.

If an ordinary cultivator with mixed spiritual roots faced such violent medicinal power, just by guiding him to widen his meridians, he would have to endure pain like skin peeling and cramping.

However, Lin Yuan, as the only one in a million with golden spiritual roots, showed an almost terrifying advantage at this moment.

The gold master kills in horror, and his quality is the strongest.
